name: computer_control
description:
Perform one approved Windows action against a fresh, single-use observation. Target either captured-image coordinates or observation-scoped UI Automation element ids. Identity, visual/semantic freshness and input ownership are revalidated. A successful result includes a new observation and change verification: inspect it and reuse its observationId without another capture. If capture is missing or effects uncertain, observe before further input.

invoke/set_value use semantic patterns without moving the pointer; type_text uses keyboard input. Auto delivery prefers UI Automation for supported element clicks. set_value requires an advertised writable Value pattern and supports replacement, clearing and multiline text. Background delivery never falls back to foreground input.

action.description: Approved desktop input action to perform.

observation_id.description: Fresh token returned by computer_observe or the previous computer_control result.

window_id.description: Window id from the referenced observation.

element_id.description: Observation-scoped semantic element id. Preferred over x/y for click, move_mouse, scroll, invoke, set_value, and exact-target type_text.

to_element_id.description: Observation-scoped destination element id for drag.

coordinate_space.description: How x/y/to_x/to_y are interpreted. Defaults to captured_image_pixels.

x.description: X in the referenced captured image. For pointer actions, supply x/y or element_id, never both.

y.description: Y in the referenced captured image. For pointer actions, supply x/y or element_id, never both.

to_x.description: Drag destination in the captured image. Supply to_x/to_y or to_element_id, never both.

to_y.description: Drag destination in the captured image. Supply to_x/to_y or to_element_id, never both.

button.description: Mouse button for click. Defaults to left.

scroll_x.description: Horizontal wheel steps; positive scrolls right.

scroll_y.description: Vertical wheel steps; positive scrolls down.

text.description: set_value replaces/clears 0..65536 characters. type_text enters 1..8000 characters with at most 32 newline/tab controls. Prefer advertised set_value for forms and multiline text. Password fields and other controls are rejected.

key_sequence.description: One chord such as ctrl+s, shift+tab, escape, or f5. Non-final keys must be modifiers; bare text-producing keys are rejected. Required for key.

reason.description: Optional reason, summarized by character count in approval and audit output rather than persisted verbatim.

include_elements.description: Include semantic elements in the fresh post-action observation. Defaults to true.

max_elements.description: Maximum semantic elements in the post-action observation. Defaults to 120.

capture_mode.description: raw returns the normal post-action screenshot; som overlays semantic element ids. Defaults to raw.

approval_scope.description: action (default), or window_session to request a reusable user grant bound to the verified process/window and task. Fresh observations remain required; this never grants access automatically.

delivery.description: auto prefers UI Automation for supported element clicks. background requires a semantic pattern; no foreground fallback. The application may activate itself. foreground forces pointer/keyboard input; invoke/set_value remain background.

drag_duration_ms.description: Drag duration in milliseconds, defaults to 400. Increase for applications requiring a longer hold. Only valid for drag.
